archetypes.name: dyn-import-correctness
archetypes.rationale: Verify that the module split has correct cross-module imports and no missing names
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the split of design_lifecycle.py into 11 sub-modules. Check that: (1) each sub-module's import statements correctly resolve all referenced names; (2) the design_lifecycle.py shim re-exports all names that external consumers reference; (3) no circular imports exist between the new modules; (4) the test monkeypatching updates target the correct sub-module namespaces. Focus on python/larch/design/design_*.py and the updated test files. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
